claim: A simple but effective little trick for living with intention, suggested with brushing your teeth or putting on your shoes

claim: For the intention trick with your teeth: you probably brush with your dominant hand. Start the morning with the other and say to yourself "I'm starting today in a new and different way. I'm starting today with intention."
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Brushing your teeth with the other hand is a small thing but a big thing: breaking a really powerful long-term habit, minor as it might seem, into intention is really powerful and helps you harness intention through the day
name: Discipline and intention

claim: For the intention trick with your shoes: you probably put one on and tie them in a particular order. claim: Testosterone, as talked about with its triggers, means a bigger view than the molecule, which itself isn't just total testosterone but free testosterone, conversion into DHT and a lot more

For testosterone, what matters to us as men is not some arbitrary number on a test but how we feel: the overall testosterone fire and its impacts on strength, confidence, physical recovery, muscle mass, sexual energy and drive, sexual performance, if you will, erections, all kind of part of the same fire
For testosterone, the big picture seems to be that it is a big picture: not one thing drags the fire down, and not one thing will magically solve it

The big picture of testosterone seems to be that a bunch of things will either sort of trigger a reduction or trigger a boost; some may change a test result, some may not, but either way they affect how you feel and perform
Talked about previously: we're very much like a bucket holding our life force energy, here testosterone, the masculine fire
For the bucket of testosterone, the masculine fire, plug as many holes in the bottom as possible and add as many things at the top as we can: negative triggers to avoid, positive ones to add
Testosterone is a complete picture, so we need to kind of address both sides of it, negative triggers and positive ones
A quick rundown of testosterone triggers, without much detail: there's a whole world of information out there and lots of previous episodes

The suggestion for testosterone triggers: a few on each side will kind of stand out to you. The point isn't to check off every single thing immediately, but to look at your life and circumstances and take the little nuggets: "I should probably pay attention to this and this, and maybe I should try this and this"
Negative triggers drag the masculine fire of testosterone down, short and/or long term

A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: ejaculation, especially frequent, especially alone, no surprise: the more we ejaculate, the more it basically drags this fire down. A big one, with tons more in previous episodes
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: porn, related to ejaculation but separate, not always directly connected to it, is in and of itself a negative trigger
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: shitty food crushes your hormones, testosterone included: you eat shitty, you drag down your fire, period
name: Clean eating

claim: A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: sleep disruptions
Sleep is huge: the majority of the actual hormone, testosterone, is produced at night, and stress, recovery and pain are affected without enough of it
Sleep is in a lot of ways our superpower: we need enough of it, and enough quality sleep
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: physical stagnation: we're not meant to sit
Testosterone and the masculine fire, when it really comes down to it, are basically "get shit done juice": our body responds when we place demands on it, and sitting and doing nothing places none

A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: a lack of presence, now-ness and inner peace leads to stress, which crushes the fire and the hormone, to being emotionally triggered and at times not necessarily stable, and to arguments and disruptions in relationships, sucking the masculine force out of us
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: excess screen time basically tells your body it doesn't really need this fire, with no demands placed
Unless you're sort of a workaholic, most likely a lot of excess screen time is social media, TV, the unproductive things

A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: comfort, and staying stuck in old shitty patterns: from a primal standpoint, not challenging ourselves or taking risks to create the new thing we want places no demands on our body and on the universe, and over time, especially this one, it drags you down
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: the energetic middle

Talked about previously: the energetic edges, very still, as in meditation, and very intense, as in intense training. Those edges (not their only forms) are really where the magic of life is, where we grow and heal
Intensity asks the body for more fire, more testosterone
Stillness is where we recover, heal and reduce stress, letting the fire of testosterone thrive
The neutral zone in the middle, between stillness and intensity, is kind of where our fire goes to die
Some stretches of days you just have to bust stuff out, but as much as possible push into true stillness and real intensity
A negative trigger, dragging the testosterone fire down short and/or long term: fat: the more fat on our body, the worse hormonally, for the molecule and for the overall fire
Really simple: long term, getting leaner matters for testosterone
Positive triggers add to the bucket of testosterone, the masculine fire

A positive trigger for testosterone: non-ejaculatory, high-vibe masturbation and/or sex absolutely fires up the masculine fire, with three keys: non-ejaculatory, without porn, and with awareness and mindfulness
A positive trigger for testosterone: lifting heavy stuff, huge: it really fires up your hormones in a powerful way

Lifting heavy can look different, kettlebells, dumbbells, deadlifts, squats, even ramped-up bodyweight work, but we need to move heavy stuff: a fact we cannot get around as men, if we want to be the strongest we can be, with the testosterone fire strong
A positive trigger for testosterone: sun: its effects on our hormones and testosterone are well documented, and beyond the molecule, sunlight does so much for us
name: Sun and sunlight

claim: At a tougher time of year, we can still soak some sun up on sunny days, even when it's cold
name: Sun and sunlight

claim: A positive trigger for testosterone: cold exposure, which doesn't need to be hugely excessive: a cold shower, a little cold outside, maybe a workout in the cold to get some sun
Cold exposure triggers various things physiologically and sort of energetically and spiritually that fire up testosterone, the masculine fire
A positive trigger for testosterone: super clean power food, the opposite of shitty food: stuff in the middle is meh, the really good stuff really fires us up
name: Clean eating

claim: Personally, based on current knowledge and experience, the suggestion for super clean power food is to focus on meat and organs, pastured eggs, things like that, a topic of its own
name: Clean eating

claim: A positive trigger for testosterone: a solid night's sleep: consistent quality sleep really helps energize you and definitely improves your hormonal state and the testosterone fire
A positive trigger for testosterone: taking action that excites and challenges you

A lot of times we get more of the testosterone fire from placing demands on ourselves: a lot of how our body and nature respond is to demands, just as heavier weights make your body get stronger to adapt
Challenge yourself and your body responds with what you need, part of which is testosterone, this get-stuff-done fire
